needs_atom.missing: 'Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and can't be blocked by more than one creature.': no maximum-blocker restriction (CR 509.1b). DeclareBlockersEvent preventions judge one blocker/attacker pair at a time (replacements.py _pair_vetoed) and no predicate counts the blockers already declared on an attacker; MENACE is the opposite (minimum two). Without it the equipped creature could be double-blocked (weaker) and dropping the clause is not allowed. (The +1/+1 has the B5a-equipped-pt shape; the ETB 'create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token, then attach this Equipment to it' would need ATTACH to the created token via the result register, untested.)
